ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Shared tooling for testing RimWorld mods with Pickle, the Gherkin runner that plays scenarios in a real game. Each tool is a companion mod that holds Pickle steps: reveal and hide a main-bar button through RIMMSQOL, film a scenario every N ticks, open the research window by name, give a scenario a colonist of any xenotype or kind. Development only: never published to the Workshop, no Defs, nothing to play. This mod as a whole carries only the identity of the repository; the tools are the folders beside it.
IF I GO QUIET If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
AI-GENERATED The code, the checks and the documents were written with Claude (Anthropic) under human direction and review. The icon and the preview were generated with an AI image model.
THANKS To Malte Schulze for shipping RIMMSQOL's source, to the authors of Pickle, and to the authors of Harmony.
